name: Numeral
description: AI驱动的销售税合规平台，覆盖90多个国家的增值税和商品服务税合规，集成超过40个计费、财务和ERP系统
description_en: AI-driven sales tax compliance platform handling VAT and GST compliance in 90+ countries, integrating with 40+ billing, financial and ERP systems
why_matters: 刚完成1亿美元C轮融资，由Insight Partners领投，Salesforce Ventures等知名投资方参与，解决跨市场销售税合规这一日益复杂的运营挑战
why_matters_en: Closed $100M Series C led by Insight Partners with Salesforce Ventures participating, addressing increasingly complex cross-market sales tax compliance operational challenges
latest_news: 完成1亿美元C轮融资，由Insight Partners领投
latest_news_en: Closed $100M Series C led by Insight Partners
source_title: Pair of $400m rounds drive this week’s FinTech funding

evidence.quote: Numeral, an AI-driven sales tax compliance platform, has closed a $100m Series C round

Numeral provides sales tax compliance across nexus monitoring, registrations, tax calculation, filings, remittance and exemption certificate management. It also handles VAT and GST compliance in more than 90 countries and integrates with more than 40 billing, financial and ERP systems.

name: Flow Engineering
description: 为硬件设计提供AI工具的初创公司，通过AI代理自动将CAD图纸与产品需求、仿真结果和其他测试对齐，使硬件迭代速度接近软件开发
description_en: AI startup offering tools for hardware design that automatically align CAD drawings with product requirements, simulation results, and other testing through AI agents
why_matters: Flow Engineering获得了包括Valor Equity Partners、Atreides Management和Sequoia Capital等顶级投资机构的B轮融资，估值达到7.5亿美元，已获得Anduril、Rivian、Joby Aviation、通用汽车等多家知名硬件公司客户，在硬件设计AI化这一新兴领域建立了显著优势
why_matters_en: Flow Engineering secured Series B funding at $750M valuation from top-tier investors including Valor Equity Partners, Atreides Management, and Sequoia Capital, and has already attracted major hardware companies like Anduril, Rivian, Joby Aviation, and General Motors as customers in the emerging hardware design AI space
latest_news: 2026年9月30日宣布完成5000万美元B轮融资，估值7.5亿美元，由Valor Equity Partners和Atreides Management共同领投，Sequoia Capital跟投，前Sequoia合伙人Roelof Botha加入董事会
latest_news_en: Announced $50M Series B funding at $750M valuation on September 30, 2026, co-led by Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management, with participation from Sequoia Capital and Roelof Botha joining the board
source_title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation

evidence.quote: Flow Engineering , a startup that offers AI tools for hardware design, has raised a $50 million Series B round at a $750 million valuation from some big-name investors
former Sequoia partner Roelof Botha, who invested as an individual investor. Botha has joined Flow's board, too.
Flow is tackling the difficulties of hardware design by offering AI agents that automatically align CAD drawings with product requirements, simulation results, and other testing

name: Restate
description: 为AI代理和后端应用提供持久性执行的新一代基础设施平台,使开发者能够专注于核心开发工作而无需处理底层管道
description_en: Next-generation infrastructure platform providing durable execution for AI agents and backend applications, allowing developers to focus on core work while handling plumbing automatically
why_matters: 由Apache Flink创始人打造,该开源技术已支撑银行、流媒体和SaaS领域的实时数据使用;A轮融资2000万美元,总融资2700万美元,已被数百家公司包括财富500强企业使用
why_matters_en: Built by creators of Apache Flink, the open-source technology underpinning real-time data use across banking, streaming media and SaaS sectors; raised $20M Series A with $27M total funding and used by hundreds of companies including Fortune 500 firms
latest_news: 2026年9月完成由Singular领投、Redpoint Ventures和Capital One Ventures参与的2000万美元A轮融资,将在旧金山设立商业中心扩展美国市场
latest_news_en: Raised $20M Series A led by Singular with participation from Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures in September 2026, expanding to US market with new commercial hub in San Francisco

evidence.quote: The funding round in Berlin-founded Restate was led by European VC Singular, with participation from Redpoint Ventures and Capital One Ventures. Restate has now raised $27m in total
The founders of Restate created Apache Flink, an open-source technology that underpins real-time data use across banking, streaming media and software-as-a-service sectors
Restate, founded in 2024, says it's used by hundreds of companies, including Fortune 500 firms

name: Satlyt
description: 为卫星构建AI运行软件的平台,让多颗卫星共享大型计算任务,通过在轨AI决策降低数据传输成本并提高运营效率
description_en: Software platform enabling AI models to run on satellites, allowing multiple satellites to share computing workloads and reducing downlink costs through on-orbit decision-making
why_matters: 由前Google云计算和SpaceX工程师创立,已在两次演示任务中部署软件,通过在Momentus卫星上运行Google DeepMind的Gemma模型将传输数据量削减超过60%,每颗卫星每年可节省数十万美元
why_matters_en: Founded by former Google Cloud and SpaceX engineer, has already flown software on two demonstration missions, achieved 60%+ transmission size reduction using Google DeepMind's Gemma model on Momentus spacecraft, saving hundreds of thousands of dollars per satellite annually
latest_news: 获得800万美元种子轮融资,软件将于本周四搭载SpaceX火箭发射,与Google的Project Suncatcher原型一同进入轨道
latest_news_en: Raised $8M seed round, software launching Thursday on SpaceX rocket alongside Google's Project Suncatcher prototype
source_title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites

evidence.quote: The company has raised an $8 million seed round, Afullo exclusively told TechCrunch.
The Kenyan American engineer previously worked in Google's cloud computing business before a brief stint at SpaceX's Starlink communications network in 2024.

Earlier this year, Satlyt deployed Google DeepMind's Gemma AI model onboard a spacecraft operated by Momentus. The model cut the size of a transmission about onboard software errors by more than 60%, the kind of efficiency that Afullo says can save hundreds of thousands of dollars per satellite each year.

name: FRANK
description: 为保险经纪人提供AI驱动的虚拟助手平台,自动处理行政工作流程,包括报价请求、理赔跟进和客户信息更新
description_en: AI-powered virtual assistant platform for insurance brokers that automates back-office workflows including quote requests, claims follow-up and client information updates
why_matters: FRANK通过AI操作员技术解决了保险经纪人80%的时间浪费在行政工作上的行业痛点,已在不到12个月内获得350多家保险机构使用,每月处理70000项后台任务,每位经纪人每周平均节省约10小时的行政工作时间
why_matters_en: FRANK addresses the industry pain point where brokers spend 80% of their time on back-office tasks through its AI Operator technology, achieving adoption by over 350 insurance agencies in under 12 months, processing 70,000 monthly tasks and saving brokers approximately 10 hours per week
latest_news: 完成290万欧元融资,由Armilar和Start Ventures领投,用于技术研发和2027年国际扩张准备
latest_news_en: Raised €2.9M led by Armilar and Start Ventures to develop technology and prepare for international expansion in 2027
source_title: FRANK raises €2.9M to cut paperwork for insurance brokers

evidence.quote: Portuguese insurtech FRANK has raised €2.9 million in a funding round led by Armilar and Start Ventures
FRANK began commercialising its platform less than 12 months ago and is now used by more than 350 insurance agencies and brokerages, representing over 1,500 users across Portugal
FRANK has developed what it calls an AI Operator, a virtual assistant designed to replicate human actions across insurance brokerage systems and portals

name: Legato
description: AI驱动的听力辅助眼镜，通过集成在镜框镜腿中的专利技术将人声与背景噪音分离并放大，适用于轻度至中度听力损失人群
description_en: AI-powered hearing glasses that distinguish voices from background noise and amplify speech while reducing unwanted sounds, designed for adults with up to moderate hearing loss
why_matters: 由前Bose高管创立，将听力辅助技术整合进日常眼镜形态，起售价999美元突破传统助听器的成本和社会认知障碍，已获1200万美元融资并正式上市销售，创始人曾主导Bose Frames和Meta Ray-Ban智能眼镜开发
why_matters_en: Founded by former Bose executives who led Bose Frames and Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses development, integrates hearing assistance into everyday eyewear starting at $999, addressing cost and stigma barriers of traditional hearing aids with $12M funding and commercial availability
latest_news: 2026年10月1日正式推出Legato Frames听力眼镜产品，可通过官网及美国部分眼科机构购买，支持视力保险覆盖
latest_news_en: Launched Legato Frames hearing glasses on October 1, 2026, available for purchase on website and through select U.S. eye care providers with vision insurance coverage
source_title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses

evidence.quote: The official launch of the glasses comes a few weeks after the startup emerged from stealth with $12 million in funding from Neotribe Ventures, Listen, and Village Global.

Legato was founded in 2024 by Mehul Trivedi and Steve Romine, who bring deep experience in wearables and hearing care from Bose, where Trivedi led the creation of Bose Frames and Romine ran the hearing aids division.

Unlike traditional hearing aids, which often use directional microphones to focus on sounds coming from a particular direction and can struggle in noisy environments, Legato takes a different approach. Its AI-powered system distinguishes voices from background noise and amplifies voices while reducing unwanted sounds.

name: Peripheral Labs
description: 为体育市场构建空间智能技术，专注于实时体育的体积视频捕捉和无标记追踪基础设施，基于机器人技术和自动驾驶汽车感知的突破
description_en: Building spatial intelligence tech for sports market, focusing on volumetric video capture and markerless tracking infrastructure for live sports, based on breakthroughs in robotics and autonomous vehicle perception
why_matters: 开发大型重建模型能够快速将二维图像转换为完全可导航的三维视频用于实时体育和教练分析，并在北美建立了NBA之外的首个生物力学篮球投篮实验室，解决了体积视频的三大障碍：质量、成本和速度
why_matters_en: Developed large reconstruction model (LRM) that quickly turns 2D images into fully navigable 3D video for live sports and coaching, established North America's first biomechanics basketball shooting lab outside NBA, tackling three major barriers to volumetric video: quality, cost, and speed
latest_news: 聘请前Meta Reality Labs产品负责人Shaun Carrigan担任首席产品官，并于两个月前获得870万美元种子轮融资
latest_news_en: Hired former Meta Reality Labs head of product Shaun Carrigan as first CPO, raised $8.7M USD seed funding two months ago
source_title: Peripheral hires former Meta Reality Labs exec to lead volumetric video push

evidence.quote: Two months ago, the startup announced another $8.7 million USD ($12.4 million CAD) in seed funding led by Toronto's Deloitte Ventures and Montréal-based Inovia Capital, with support from existing backers Khosla Ventures and Entrepreneurs First.
Founded in 2024 by CEO Kelvin Cui and CTO Mustafa Khan, a pair of University of Toronto robotics graduates and former self-driving racecar builders
In May, Peripheral established what it claims was North America's first biomechanics basketball shooting lab outside of the NBA.

name: Photon
description: 帮助开发者构建通过 iMessage 和 WhatsApp 等消息应用运行的 AI 代理的开发平台，提供统一 API、可扩展渠道框架、CLI 和可观测性套件
description_en: Developer platform that helps build AI agents operating through messaging apps like iMessage and WhatsApp, offering unified API, extensible channel framework, CLI, and observability suite
why_matters: 在四个月内实现收入增长10倍、吸引超过40,000名开发者注册，流失率低于3%，并获得Vercel、Gradient等机构450万美元种子融资。提供SOC 2 Type II和HIPAA合规的托管平台，支持开发者绕过应用发现瓶颈，直接通过用户已使用的消息应用触达用户
why_matters_en: Achieved 10x revenue growth in four months, attracted over 40,000 developer sign-ups with less than 3% churn, and raised $4.5M seed funding from Vercel, Gradient and others. Offers SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA-compliant managed platform, enabling developers to bypass app discovery bottlenecks by reaching users through messaging apps they already use
latest_news: 2026年10月1日宣布获得450万美元种子轮融资，由Gradient和A*共同领投，Vercel、HSG等参与投资
latest_news_en: Announced $4.5 million seed funding on October 1, 2026, co-led by Gradient and A* with participation from Vercel, HSG and others
source_title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents.

evidence.quote: Photon, which helps developers build agents that work over iMessage and WhatsApp, now has $4.5 million in seed funding to develop its products.
The raise comes after the company signed up over 40,000 developers and grew its revenue 10x in just four months, it says.
Today, the open source version of Photon still accounts for 98% of its use.

name: CodeRabbit
description: AI 驱动的代码审查平台，帮助工程团队自动化日常代码审查流程，2026年8月以15亿美元估值完成1.43亿美元融资
description_en: AI-powered code review platform that automates code review workflows for engineering teams, raised $143 million at $1.5 billion valuation in August 2026
why_matters: 代码审查是每个工程团队的日常关键环节，CodeRabbit 占据这一核心工作流位置，使其产品难以被简化为功能模块。工程师从底层自发采用该工具，随着使用范围扩大公司付费，这种自下而上的收入模式已被验证有效
why_matters_en: Code review sits in the daily path of every engineering team, a workflow position that keeps the product from shrinking into a feature. Bottom-up engineering adoption converts to real revenue as usage spreads
latest_news: 2026年8月完成B轮和C轮融资共1.43亿美元，估值达15亿美元，CRV参与投资
latest_news_en: Raised $143 million across Series B and C rounds at $1.5 billion valuation in August 2026, with CRV participation
source_title: CRV | AI Startups to Invest In: 2026 Investor Guide

website_verification.title: AI Code Reviews | CodeRabbit | Try for Free. CodeRabbit

evidence.quote: The AI code review company raised $143 million at a $1.5 billion valuation in August 2026.
Code review sits in the daily path of every engineering team, a workflow position that keeps the product from shrinking into a feature.
CRV led CodeRabbit's Series A and participated in its Series B and C.

name: StudyStash
description: 自适应学习平台，将课程内容转化为个性化闪卡、练习测试和播客，技术会随着学生学习进行调整，帮助他们专注于薄弱环节
description_en: Adaptive learning platform that turns course content into personalized flashcards, practice tests and podcasts, with technology that adapts as students learn to help them focus on weaker areas
why_matters: 在创始人毕业一年内即被Kortext收购，已扩展至三大洲160多所教育机构，包括加州州立大学、明尼苏达州立大学等，获得UCL、帝国理工学院和牛津大学高层组成的顾问委员会支持，与美国2800多所高等教育机构合作的EAB建立合作关系
why_matters_en: Acquired by Kortext just one year after founders graduated, expanded to 160+ institutions across three continents including California State University and Minnesota State, backed by advisory board with senior figures from UCL, Imperial College London and Oxford, partnered with EAB which works with 2,800+ US higher education institutions
latest_news: 被教育科技公司Kortext收购，创始人Ben Ward和Jonathan Graham将继续担任CEO和CTO，公司将作为独立品牌运营，两位创始人正迁往硅谷继续美国市场扩张
latest_news_en: Acquired by edtech company Kortext, founders Ben Ward and Jonathan Graham will remain as CEO and CTO with StudyStash operating as distinct brand, founders relocating to Silicon Valley to continue US expansion
source_title: AI study platform StudyStash acquired by Kortext after rapid global expansion

evidence.quote: Ben Ward and Jonathan Graham, who met while studying computer science at the University of Birmingham and working together on PwC's technology degree apprenticeship

The platform is now used by tens of thousands of students across more than 160 institutions in the UK, Europe, the US and Africa, including California State University, Minnesota State, Colorado State, the University of Oulu and RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences

StudyStash is an adaptive learning platform that turns course content into personalised flashcards, practice tests and podcasts. Its technology adapts as students learn, helping them focus on weaker areas while giving lecturers and student success teams insight into where support is needed
